name: Amittai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: He restored the coast of Israel according to the word spoken by Jonah the son of Amittai, for the Most High saw the bitter affliction of Israel and would not blot out their name.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II
